vt1025016.title: Nikon 1 V1 10.1MP Mirrorless Camera White with 10mm f/2.8 Lens Kit and Box
vt1025016.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1025016.details: Nikon 1 V1 mirrorless camera in white (Nikon 1 mount, 10.1 megapixels) with the 1 NIKKOR 10mm f/2.8 slim lens kit. Condition: very clean and little used, with no scratches on the body. The original box has some dirt from storage at home. Operation was checked and the camera shoots normally. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera with the 1 NIKKOR 10mm f/2.8 lens and its lens cap, the strap, the battery charger, an AV cable, a USB cable, the body cap and rear lens cap, the printed manuals and discs, and the original box. No separate battery or memory card is shown, so please do not expect them.
